_comment: CROSS-RUNTIME CONTRACT for the verification enforcement policy (Auth Slice 6A).
Every runtime that evaluates the policy MUST produce these verdicts. Today that is the
browser (sokoni-verify-policy.js as a classic script) and Node (the same file required as
a CommonJS module). Slice 6B adds a third consumer inside functions/, which must assert
against THIS FILE rather than against a copied constant.
A byte-identical cutoff string on both sides proves the two sides agree about a string.
It does not prove they agree about a DATE — different parsing, a timezone assumption, or
a > where the other has >= all survive that check and diverge exactly at the boundary,
which is the one place a mistake locks somebody out. These vectors pin the behaviour
creationTime appears in both formats Firebase actually emits: RFC-1123 from
UserRecord.metadata.creationTime, and ISO-8601 from anything that has normalised it.

vectors.label: sentinel · account created today · still disabled
sentinel · account created AFTER the sentinel date · STILL disabled
vectors.why: off must mean off at every date, not merely at plausible ones

vectors.label: sentinel · account created exactly AT the sentinel instant · disabled
active · one millisecond before the cutoff · grandfathered
active · EXACTLY at the cutoff · ENFORCED
vectors.why: the cutoff is the instant enforcement begins — half-open [cutoff, infinity)

vectors.label: active · one millisecond after the cutoff · enforced
active · long before · grandfathered (this is the production population)
active · RFC-1123 before cutoff · grandfathered
vectors.why: UserRecord.metadata.creationTime is RFC-1123, not ISO — both must parse

vectors.label: active · RFC-1123 expressing exactly the cutoff instant · ENFORCED
vectors.why: the boundary must not depend on which of the two formats carried the date

vectors.label: active · non-UTC offset resolving to before the cutoff · grandfathered
vectors.why: comparison is on epoch millis; a timezone must not move the boundary

vectors.label: active · non-UTC offset resolving to after the cutoff · enforced
active · creationTime missing · GRANDFATHERED (relaxes, never locks out)
vectors.why: production holds one account with no provider record; an undateable account must not be locked out

vectors.label: active · metadata object absent entirely · grandfathered
